specs.title: application API preserves send identity, rejects corrupt retained acceptance, and validates event author/read scope
autonomous Liquid Glass UI owns identity and offline outbox, connects through real RTC, receives signed confirmations and survives reload
autonomous social actions and safe signed site builder persist and remain viewable after author closes
production worker keeps private keys out of replies and recovers an applied send after the UI response is lost
a second tab cannot take ownership of a live application profile and an unknown or corrupt profile is never silently reset
cached application code and encrypted profile reopen when the static host is unavailable, without installing the PWA
corrupted cached worker is rejected offline and recovered only from verified available code
both pending outboxes deliver after completing signalling; modes stay separate and diagnostics contain no secrets
closing while a code is being generated releases the late pending peer
imported contact immediately appears once, survives reload and becomes the first real DM without a duplicate
relay consent through the UI gates a real A to B to C path and does not grant B private reading
Browser owns compatible identities/vaults/bundles: real Node and Go positive and negative controls
encrypted IndexedDB persists, coordinates two pages, rejects corruption and preserves pins on failed admission
lock during unlock cannot resurrect keys; missing authenticated state is not replaced with empty success
real WebRTC transfers encrypted chunks and an offline author's reader seeds identical bytes to a new reader
WebRTC rejects a correctly framed corrupt bundle before storage and rejects admission failure without ACK
identity recovery is compatible and cannot overwrite an existing profile; quota eviction retains pinned objects
browser application bundle/ledger commit is atomic, pending reservations survive eviction pressure and IDB abort preserves prior state
browser identity and group authority refuse all small-order reference keys and noncanonical aliases
browser, Node and Go verify shared group certificates, fresh consents, removal and strict signing ownership
an allowed large site image saves through the UI and survives encrypted browser restart
a single touch activates compact sidebar destinations after an open conversation hides the dock
browser WebRTC to browser WebSocket to real node daemon, reverse transfer and invitation revocation
browser WebRTC to browser WebSocket to real native daemon, reverse transfer and invitation revocation
private four-medium route WebRTC-WebSocket-TCP-serial, partition/heal and restarted browser seeder with author offline
late native ACK cannot leave an orphan retry assembly or close an otherwise healthy WebSocket
initial language, product guide and appearance work without altering identity form values
English and Spanish identities exchange encrypted messages and files without translating authored text
a blocked tab can change UI language while the owning identity remains intact
unavailable preference storage and localized form validation never reset a profile
saving one preference does not hide a different unsaved preference
private values larger than the metadata index survive restart without becoming peer inventory
legacy embedded values migrate lazily and encrypted value rows remain outside peer access
bundle and private-value mutations commit together, and corruption cannot silently reset a value
private-value byte and total budgets reject excess without losing committed values
multiple private values share one commit and a concurrent writer cannot remove a reader's snapshot
automatic A-B-C mesh: consent controls, own sends while paused, partition/heal and restarted reader takeover with author offline
one network owner per profile and concurrent consent/preferences do not resurrect revoked relay
fragment scheduling preempts bulk with SOS, gives bulk a fair turn, and cancels relayed bytes without closing own traffic
packet bounds reject expiry, hop loops and tampering; retained flood is bounded
low-power defers bulk on a live link, keeps SOS moving and never revives an expired queued packet
browser routing packets cross real native TCP routers; native packet bytes verify in the browser and corruption never forwards
opaque packet corruption is rejected by the browser mesh before storage or forwarding, with valid controls on both sides
managed relay revocation cancels an in-flight forwarded packet and keeps an authored SOS on that same open link
browser site API retains stable address, exact replay and history across reopen; a missing head never falls back
v1 readable sites reject forged author, signature and payload; opaque private seeding confers no editing authority
v2 readable sites reject forged author, signature and payload; opaque private seeding confers no editing authority
storage exhaustion keeps exact authorized publication private and the offline application resumes after reopening
concurrent recovered identities require explicit heads and retain both histories after conflict resolution
private profile transactions commit deletion and values together and close their handles
caught failures, abandoned async calls and profile lock cannot partially commit a transaction
browser catalog keeps preparation private and resumes the exact signed snapshot after reopening
two browser profiles sharing a base can reserve only one publication
expired browser preparations remain terminal, preserve counters and reject a stale session
IndexedDB abort and corrupted private staging cannot leave partial site state or silently replace signed bytes
private transactions enforce final quota while an atomic replacement fits at the storage boundary
standalone table component filters literal data, sorts, paginates and rejects active content without mutating the source
table file import validates before replacement, preserves typed nulls, undoes changes and exports literal CSV safely
table controls and import failures use en-GB while authored data retains its language
table controls and import failures use es-ES while authored data retains its language
real table editor types decimal cells, preserves drafts, publishes signed data and permits read-only queries after the author closes
three multilingual identities edit signed pages, preserve original text and seed to a new reader after author closes
version 1 sites cross RTC, WebSocket and TCP through node, heal a partition and survive with only a restarted reader
version 1 sites cross RTC, WebSocket and TCP through native, heal a partition and survive with only a restarted reader
version 2 sites cross RTC, WebSocket and TCP through node, heal a partition and survive with only a restarted reader
version 2 sites cross RTC, WebSocket and TCP through native, heal a partition and survive with only a restarted reader
web users copy pages, reorder with keyboard, reopen encrypted drafts and read the signed result after the author closes
real UI publishes public and private revisions, reads fixed history and restores original privacy without granting readers authorship
two user-restored identities preserve a visible fork until the UI explicitly reviews and confirms all versions
studio reports local validation, preserves the saved draft and keeps keyboard focus after saving
lost worker publication response keeps the editor frozen and resumes the same version through the UI
application waits for an owned closing lease and never takes a live profile from another tab
publication and history controls work in en-GB and keep authored text across a language change
publication and history controls work in es-ES and keep authored text across a language change
browser application creates resources once, keeps copy failures recoverable and checks blocking in the actual copy transaction
browser application leaves a failed read-back pending and recovers its exact signature after reopening
expired browser resource intent keeps its result and requires a new explicit creation
the maximum valid page inspects every resource without exhausting the browser command budget

specs.title: browser resource creation keeps its signature private until durable preparation, reopens and recovers one exact result
locking during resource signing aborts the private transaction and invalidates its old catalogue
resource library works in en-GB on a compact dark reduced-motion interface without translating authored filenames
resource library works in es-ES on a compact dark reduced-motion interface without translating authored filenames
browser resource admission rejects readable malformed bodies, preserves opaque seeding and keeps summaries distinct from full data
optional data crosses RTC and WS through node only on request and a restarted browser seeds it after author shutdown
optional data crosses RTC and WS through native only on request and a restarted browser seeds it after author shutdown
resource UI recovers a lost reply with one operation identity and no silent duplicate
resource UI recovers a lost request with one operation identity and no silent duplicate
browser signed-page resource API separates inspection from obtaining bytes and preserves third-party authorship
browser resource inspection rejects corrupted IndexedDB bytes and never returns an expired file
resource polling keeps the obtain action busy until its own real Worker reply arrives
signed resource reader follows all site palettes independently of the application theme
switching resource previews never associates a new filename or MIME with the previous file URL
late site inventory preserves an already verified reader and focus; failed refresh clears the old view
resource library builds a private table through the UI and prevents accidental public publication
three accounts create, publish and retrieve optional files entirely through the UI; a restarted reader seeds after the author closes
real browser, Node and Go agree on signed site snapshots while reading keys cannot edit them
multipage studio saves encrypted draft, rejects executable imports and a consenting reader seeds it to a new browser after author closes
studio keyboard navigation, nested drag, duplicate, reparent and page references stay editable on a narrow screen
dense three-level compositions keep all controls inside their blocks and preserve contrast across palettes and app themes
production worker publishes and recovers exact site requests, refuses forged snapshots and does not export signing helpers
portable curves match RFC 7748, reject invalid reading keys and work when native curve operations fail
identity lifecycle remains valid across 512 generated and reimported signing/reading key pairs
